title: Motion Sensor
description: A motion sensor reporting detection status and activity level, emitting events as motion starts and stops.

motionDetected.description: Whether motion is currently being detected.

lastMotion.description: Timestamp of the most recently detected motion.

motion.description: Fires when motion begins, carrying the activity level and timestamp.

noMotion.description: Fires when motion ends, carrying how long the motion period lasted.

durationMs.description: Duration of the motion period in milliseconds
